message:
Last winter, we had one of those surprise snowstorms that caught everyone off guard. I remember my neighbor, a real skeptic about my little emergency stash, chuckling as I filled up my car with gas and stocked up on bread and milk. Fast forward to the next day when his driveway was buried under two feet of snow while I was cozy with hot cocoa, my pantry brimming with snacks. 

I couldn’t help but feel a little smug as I waved to him from my well-prepared fortress. 

Sometimes, a little bit of preparation can turn a potential headache into a warm and cozy day at home. What little tricks do you have up your sleeve for those surprise weather moments?
